docs.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026 — Next Steps
docs.text: Microsoft Ignite brings AI into the flow of human ambition — from agents and platforms to security and data. Engage with session-specific content in your environment with interactive repos to further your learning for your own purposes. Click on a topic to see the repos for each session.

docs.title: Session Topics
docs.text:
Explore lab and session repositories organized by topic to engage in interactive activities to further your learning from Microsoft Ignite. Click on each topic area to see the list of sessions and their associated repos to start.

Topic Description Cloud & AI Modernize with confidence on the cloud and AI platform. Agent Platform Ubiquitous innovation — building, deploying, and scaling agents everywhere. Security Establishing a trusted and secure platform for AI. Copilot AI in the flow of human ambition — bringing Copilot into everyday work. Data Build a unified, governed data and AI estate. Agentic Business Applications Agentifying your business processes. Frontier Transformation Adoption, governance, readiness, and business impact resources for transformation initiatives. Windows AI-ready productivity and security for every employee. Microsoft IQ Amplify your intelligence with Microsoft IQ.

docs.title: Skills Hub: Keep up the momentum
docs.text:
Microsoft Ignite may be over, but your learning journey is just getting started. Explore resources to deepen your expertise and turn inspiration into action.

News and announcements

See what's new in AI Skills Navigator. Explore the latest announcements, from AI-powered learning experiences and on-demand labs to personalized guidance, skill validation, and new ways to build expertise.

Explore the latest Microsoft Ignite announcements and uncover curated learning playlists that help you understand, apply, and build skills around each innovation.

AI-powered learning for what matters to you with AI Skills Navigator

Discover learning personalized to your role, goals and interests. Build confidence through realistic scenarios with practice boost, apply what you've learned in free, on-demand labs, and explore skilling playlists tailored to your needs.

Get started

Grow your career with Microsoft Credentials

Earn industry-recognized Microsoft Credentials that validate AI, business, and technical skills to help you grow your career.

Show what you can do with GitHub Copilot as you work, no exam required. The Microsoft Pro Badge verifies your proficiency through real-world tasks and gives you a trusted way to share your skills.

Put your skills to work with on-demand labs

New on-demand labs let you get your hands on the technology and try it for yourself. Experiment, make mistakes, troubleshoot real tasks, and build practical experience and confidence before applying those skills at work.

Explore labs
